📦 Official Microsoft Support Diagnostic Package Collector (Learn ↗)

Run this one-click PowerShell collector as Administrator to gather all logs required by Microsoft Support into a single ZIP archive on your Desktop:

PowerShell — Collect Edge Support Bundle
$dest = "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\EdgeSupportDiag_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dest -Force | Out-Null $paths = @( "$env:ALLUSERSPROFILE\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate\Log\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.log", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp\MicrosoftEdgeUpdate.log", "$env:WINDIR\Temp\msedge_installer.log", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Temp\msedge_installer.log" ) foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Copy-Item $p -Destination $dest -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } reg export "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate" "$dest\HKLM_EdgeUpdate_Policies.reg" /y 2>$null reg export "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" "$dest\HKLM_Edge_Policies.reg" /y 2>$null reg export "HKLM\SOFTWARE\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate" "$dest\HKLM_EdgeUpdate_State.reg" /y 2>$null Get-Service edgeupdate*, MicrosoftEdgeElevationService -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * > "$dest\EdgeServices.txt" Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName "MicrosoftEdgeUpdate*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-List * > "$dest\EdgeScheduledTasks.txt" Compress-Archive -Path "$dest\*" -DestinationPath "$dest.zip" -Force Write-Host "Support bundle saved to: $dest.zip (Also attach edge://policy JSON and Procmon .PML if requested)" -ForegroundColor Green

TLS Handshake, Certificate & SSL Inspection Diagnostic Lab

Inspect PEM / OpenSSL certificate dumps, detect corporate SSL/TLS interception (Zscaler/Netskope/Proxy CA), and diagnose Schannel/Chromium TLS failures.
Paste certificate details above to check expiry, SAN coverage, and corporate TLS inspection markers.
TLS 1.2 / 1.3 Failure & SSL Inspection Diagnostic Matrix:
• ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID / SEC_E_UNTRUSTED_ROOT
Corporate SSL inspection proxy (Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto, BlueCoat) resigning TLS with an internal Root CA missing from the Windows Trusted Root store or app cert bundle. Fix: Deploy Root CA via GPO/Intune or bypass SSL inspection for M365/Entra endpoints.
• ERR_SSL_VERSION_OR_CIPHER_MISMATCH
Client and server share no compatible TLS version (e.g. TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled) or cipher suite. Fix: Verify TLS 1.2/1.3 enabled in Schannel registry & Edge policies.
• ERR_CERT_REVOKED / OCSP / CRL Timeout
Browser cannot reach ocsp.* or crl.* endpoints (port 80 HTTP) due to strict firewall rules. Fix: Allow HTTP port 80 outbound to DigiCert / Microsoft PKI CRL & OCSP responders.
• ERR_CONNECTION_RESET during ClientHello (TLS Handshake)
Firewall DPI / SNI filtering or MTU blackhole dropping TLS 1.3 Post-Quantum Kyber/ML-KEM larger ClientHello packets (>1500 bytes). Fix: Test with --disable-features=PostQuantumKyber or verify path MTU.
